verdict.rationale: Lovable's own docs say you can download the codebase from Project settings → Git, sync it to a GitHub or GitLab repo you own, work locally in your IDE, and 'deploy outside Lovable'. That covers export plus running or hosting outside the platform. The docs do not explain how to move the built-in Cloud backend (database, auth, edge functions) off Lovable, and no community source confirms self-hosting, so quality is held below 9. missing for 10: documented steps for self-hosting or migrating the Cloud/Supabase backend outside Lovable, independent hands-on corroboration of running an exported app elsewhere

support.subject: As a developer, I can export the full source code and run or host the app outside the platform

citations.quote: you can download your code directly from Lovable: use the Download codebase section in Project settings → Git
you can export and sync your project to GitHub: back up your code, review changes in pull requests, work locally in your IDE, test features on branches, and deploy outside Lovable
Git sync connects a Lovable project to a repository you own on GitHub or GitLab, and keeps the two in sync automatically
Code: Your app's source code, which you can browse, edit, and download.
